name: smwblocks-anti-midway
title: Anti-Midway
description:
It's a midway, but instead of setting the midway flag and making the player respawn at the midway entrance, it does the opposite. If the player got the midway before, this will unset it, making the player respawn at the main entrance and will (optionally) remove their power-up.
Stupid? Kinda..
Evil? Definitely!

Credit is not necessary.
